title: A per-session compaction window must not dirty settings.json; the handoff hook must read the window in use
why: shiv, Oct 28 15:20 CDT (via the coordinator): running /autocompact on a session to a value other than 500k writes it into his user settings, which on his machine is the repo's tracked settings.json, leaving a stray line change.
note: Slug compact-window-off-tracked-file (coordinator's suggestion). Two defects. (1) When he runs /autocompact with a value other than 500000, Claude Code writes it into his user settings, which on his machine is the repo's tracked settings.json (autoCompactWindow, line 433 on main). The file shows a stray change, and he has to say "leave it uncommitted" to keep it out of a commit. A per-session window must not dirty the tracked file. (2) hooks/precompact_handoff.py reads only the top-level autoCompactWindow, so it misses a per-session or per-model value and can time the handoff nudge wrong; it must read the window the session really uses. Red first for each. Not measured yet: where Claude Code stores a per-session value, and whether the tracked file can be kept out of that write (for example a separate untracked user settings file); a lane reads the docs and a live session first. Related: waiting-page item 53 (a per-tier window), which shows the repo's 500k already reaches cloud sessions. Lane later; the coordinator briefs it. Port: yes, any repo whose user settings are tracked. Placed after c202 (triage 12, Oct 28). Waiting-page item 61 (per-tier context limits): shiv answered none twice (Oct 28 19:40 and 19:43 CDT). He wants per-tier limits (coordinator 1M as an Opus session, other lanes about 400k, a builder at most 300k) and is open to the per-tier setup but says it needs testing, especially for local sessions. Read from the repo: one value for every model, 500000 (settings.json autoCompactWindow, line 433); no agent file sets one. Measured by the c203 lane, Oct 28 19:45 CDT (cloud, CC 2.1.312): the variable raises the window (1000000 gives effective 980000, 400000 gives 380000, source env); an agent's own autoCompactWindow caps it (effective = the smaller of the session window incl. env and the agent value, read from the binary's resolver; a live agent probe gave no reading); local launch flags untested (the lane has no local machine). Item 61 now offers (a) set the per-tier numbers now (1000000 coordinator, 400000 lane, 300000 builder) then check the two leftovers, (b) check them first, (c) the generated settings copy. Pick a stands; the lane's red test for the settings-copy defect waits on his answer.
